name: Cold Intro
html_content:
Hi {first_name},

I came across {company_name} while researching teams in your space, and I wanted to reach out.

We help companies like yours {value_proposition}. Most teams see results within their first month.

Would you be open to a quick 15-minute call next week to see if there's a fit? If now's not a good time, no problem — just let me know.

Thanks,
{sender_name}
{sender_title}, {company_name}
